landing.heroSubtitle: Sessio sends confirmations, reminders, and waitlist updates automatically. Participants respond in one tap, and you always know who is coming.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Run group trainings without the daily back-and-forth.
landing.feature1Desc: Participants get a reminder before each training and confirm in one tap. No extra follow-up.
landing.feature2Desc: If someone drops out, the next person on the waitlist gets the spot automatically.
landing.feature3Desc: See who is coming, who cancelled, and how full each training is — all in one place.
landing.stepsSubtitle: Your participants can join right away.
landing.step1Desc: Set the sport, time, location, and number of spots.
landing.step2Desc: Share a link or join code. People can sign up in seconds.
landing.step3Desc: Reminders, confirmations, and waitlist updates run automatically.
landing.ctaSubtitle: No credit card. No complicated setup. Start with your current participants.
